tasks.title: Implement ArchiveScraper.scrape() — real Internet Archive Advanced Search fetch
tasks.description: Replace the return [] stub in agents/archive-scraper/index.ts with a real HTTP fetch. Use Node.js built-in fetch (no new deps). Import ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL and RATE_LIMIT_MS from './config'. Build URL: `${ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL}?q=${encodeURIComponent(this.config.query)}&output=json&rows=${this.config.maxResults}&fl[]=identifier,title,description,mediatype,year`. Await fetch, parse JSON — response shape is { response: { docs: Array<{identifier: string, title: string, description: string, mediatype: string, year: string|number}> } }. Map each doc to ArchiveResult: { id: doc.identifier, title: doc.title ?? '', url: `https://archive.org/details/${doc.identifier}`, mediaType: doc.mediatype ?? '', year: String(doc.year ?? ''), description: doc.description ?? '' }. Add rate limit: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, RATE_LIMIT_MS)) before return. Wrap in try/catch: on error log console.error('[ArchiveScraper] fetch failed:', err) and return []. Replace the TODO comment with: // Phase 1 — live Advanced Search fetch. Keep file under 65 lines. Do not modify the interface definitions, class signature, or constructor.
tasks.context: Phase 1 Task #4 — first live data fetch in the TikTok Content Agent pipeline. The scaffold was created in Sprint 070 (agents/archive-scraper/index.ts has ArchiveScraper class, ArchiveResult interface, and stub scrape() returning []). ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL = 'https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php' and RATE_LIMIT_MS = 1000 are already exported from agents/archive-scraper/config.ts.

(5) export const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_MB = 5.
